Subject: RE: Vendor questionnaire: data residency, retention, and deletion (draft answers)

Mina / Ben — draft answers below. I also attached a short residency fact sheet and a SOC 2 summary we can share. Please review for tone and any redlines.

Draft technical responses (hosted API):

1) Where data is stored
- Default serving region: US (multi-AZ within selected US region). Hosted API customers are served from our US cluster unless an EU region is requested via an enterprise contract.

2) Default retention windows
- Request/response payloads: Ephemeral by default. We do not persist full request payloads for routing beyond transient cache unless customer enables logging.
- Request logs and debug traces: Default retention 30 days for standard hosted accounts (used for debug and monitoring).
- Audit logs (control-plane events): Retained 90 days by default; longer retention available with enterprise plan.

3) Deletion / erasure workflow
- Tenant deletion request triggers: immediate scheduling of data purge tasks across runtime and object stores.
- Expected completion: most transient caches cleared within minutes; background purge of logs and snapshots completed within 7 days; full deletion from backups and long-term archives within 30 days. We provide a deletion attestation report on request.

4) EU-only residency
- Supported for Dedicated / Private customers and for hosted accounts with an enterprise addendum and region pinning. For pilot usage we can enable EU region routing subject to contract and capacity planning (may require minimal lead time).

5) Evidence pack
- SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted): attached.
- Residency fact sheet (attached) contains region mapping and retention defaults.

Notes / suggested DPA language: include a clause that allows customers to specify region pinning and a timeline for deletion attestation (we typically do 30-day attestation for hosted pilots). Procurement will need to confirm SLA for EU pilot.

Attachments: residency-fact-sheet.pdf, Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf

I recommend we send a slightly abbreviated, customer-facing version. Happy to take edits.

Thanks,
Irene Choi
Senior Security Engineer — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: residency-fact-sheet.pdf (PDF, 40KB); Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)]

Subject: RE: Vendor questionnaire: data residency, retention, and deletion

Hi Laura / Anil,

Thanks for the detailed questionnaire — please find our answers below and attached evidence. Short summary up front: hosted API defaults to US-based clusters and ephemeral request payload processing; we support EU-only residency for pilots under an enterprise addendum. Detailed answers follow.

Answers (concise):
- Storage / region: Default hosting: US (multi-AZ in us-west-2). EU hosting is available for pilots under a contractual region-pin; this requires an addendum to the DPA and minimal lead time (typically 7–14 business days to enable routing).
- Retention:
  * Full request payloads: not persisted by default (ephemeral). If logging is enabled by the customer, stored for troubleshooting with default retention of 30 days.
  * Debug traces & request logs: 30-day default retention (configurable for enterprise customers).
  * Control-plane / audit logs: 90-day default retention.
- Deletion / erasure: Tenant deletion triggers purge across runtime, caches, and object stores. Typical timelines: caches cleared immediately; background log and snapshot purge within 7 days; final removal from backups/archives within 30 days. We can produce a deletion attestation PDF on request after purge completes.
- Evidence: Attached are the SOC 2 Type II redacted summary and a residency fact sheet describing region mapping and retention defaults. If you need the full SOC 2 report we can share under NDA/commissioning.

Next steps / ask from BrightHarbor:
1) Confirm whether you need EU-only hosting for the pilot. If yes, please confirm procurement lead and target start date so we can reserve capacity and generate the DPA addendum.
2) Let us know if you require a shorter deletion attestation window (we typically attest within 30 days for hosted pilots).

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf; residency-fact-sheet.pdf

Best,
Mina Haddad
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Type2_summary.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); residency-fact-sheet.pdf (PDF, 40KB)]
